scripts.check: pnpm -r run typecheck && eslint . && prettier --check . && node scripts/check-invariants.mjs
scripts.check:server: pnpm --filter @zexn/shared typecheck && pnpm --filter @zexn/server typecheck && eslint apps/server packages/shared scripts && prettier --check apps/server packages/shared scripts docs && node scripts/check-invariants.mjs --scope server
scripts.check:client: pnpm --filter @zexn/shared typecheck && pnpm --filter @zexn/client typecheck && eslint apps/client packages/shared && prettier --check apps/client packages/shared docs && node scripts/check-invariants.mjs --scope client
